content: browser-use is an open source Python and TypeScript LLM driven browser automation framework, connecting model decisions to browser actions. 89.1 percent success on WebVoyager benchmark, number 1 on Odysseys leaderboard, ahead of computer use agents from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Microsoft. LLM provider agnostic, extensible via custom tools. Good fit for exploratory or agentic navigation testing rather than deterministic assertions, complements rather than replaces Playwright style scripted testing.
